name: calendar
description: Reads Google Calendar for what is waiting on you and what you are waiting on: unanswered invites, pending replies to your invites, and meetings that need preparation. Read-only.

waiting-on-me.prompt: Use the waiting-on-me skill to find what is waiting on me on Google Calendar.

waiting-on-them.prompt: Use the waiting-on-them skill to find what I am waiting on others for on Google Calendar.

action-now.prompt: Use the waiting-on-me and action-now-or-soon skills to answer action-now: what I need to act on today on Google Calendar.

action-soon.prompt: Use the waiting-on-me and action-now-or-soon skills to answer action-soon: what I need to act on soon on Google Calendar.

all.prompt: Answer all four triage questions on Google Calendar, following triage-report: action-now, action-soon, waiting-on-them, then the counts.
